name: Markets and Instruments
description: Value cash flows over time and learn what bonds, shares and futures really are.

lessonNames.l2-present-value: What future money is worth today
lessonNames.l6-yield: Yields and prices move opposite ways
lessonNames.l12-selling-what-you-do-not-own: Selling what you do not own

lessonObjectives.l1-interest-on-interest: Compute simple and compound interest over several periods.
lessonObjectives.l2-present-value: Discount a future cash flow to its present value.
lessonObjectives.l3-comparing-rates: Convert between nominal and effective annual rates.
lessonObjectives.l4-npv: Compare two streams of cash flows by net present value.
lessonObjectives.l5-pricing-a-bond: Price a bond as the present value of its coupons and principal.
lessonObjectives.l6-yield: Explain why a bond’s price falls when its yield rises.
lessonObjectives.l7-shares: Explain shares, dividends and market capitalisation.
lessonObjectives.l8-measuring-returns: Compute total, annualised and excess returns.
lessonObjectives.l9-agreeing-today: Draw the payoff of a forward contract at delivery.
lessonObjectives.l10-cost-of-carry: Derive the forward price from the cost of carry.
lessonObjectives.l11-margin: Follow daily settlement through a futures margin account.
lessonObjectives.l12-selling-what-you-do-not-own: Compute the profit and the risk of a short sale.
lessonObjectives.l13-leverage: Compute the return on equity of a leveraged position.
